title: Right derived functors on morphisms are computed by lifts to injective resolutions
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with enough injectives, $\mathcal B$ an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $v:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ an additive functor, and $R^nv$ ($n\geq0$) its right derived functors computed by injective resolutions [def-sp-left-exact-additive], [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then each $R^nv$ is a functor $\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, and for every object $X$ and every injective resolution $s_X:X\to P^\bullet$ with $P^q=0$ for $q<0$ there is an isomorphism $\iota_P^n:R^nv(X)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^n(v(P^\bullet))$, such that: for every morphism $h:X\to Y$ of $\mathcal A$, every injective resolution $s_Y:Y\to Q^\bullet$ with $Q^q=0$ for $q<0$, and every morphism of complexes $\varphi:P^\bullet\to Q^\bullet$ with $\varphi^0\circ s_X=s_Y\circ h$, one has $R^nv(h)=(\iota_Q^n)^{-1}\circ H^n(v(\varphi))\circ\iota_P^n$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: R^nv := F.rightDerived n (line 110; it is H^n of v applied to an injective resolution, as in def-sp-left-exact-additive, see the leaves lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-injective-vanishing and lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero); an injective resolution with P^q=0 for q<0 is an InjectiveResolution X (an ℕ-indexed cochain complex P.cocomplex of injectives with quasi-isomorphism P.ι from (single₀ C).obj X, whose degree-0 component is s_X); iota_P^n := (P.isoRightDerivedObj F n).hom (line 114); the hypothesis φ^0 ∘ s_X = s_Y ∘ h is the degree-0 component of w : P.ι ≫ φ = (single₀ C).map h ≫ Q.ι (equivalently the comm hypothesis of isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality, line 126, which is stated directly in degree 0); the conclusion is rightDerived_map_eq (line 164). The functoriality of R^nv is that F.rightDerived n is a Functor C D.
